instantiated_cells.justification: Section 305.003(a)(2) requires registration if a person receives or is entitled to receive compensation or reimbursement “of more than an amount determined by commission rule but not less than $200 in a calendar quarter” for direct communication to influence legislation or administrative action.

Section 305.003(a)(1) requires registration if a person makes total lobbying-related expenditures of an amount set by commission rule “but not less than $200 in a calendar quarter,” establishing at least a $200 quarterly expenditure trigger.
Section 305.0061(c) requires additional identifying details only if a gift/award/memento exceeds $50 per item, implying a $50 per-item threshold for itemized detail for those items.

unscoreable_emissions.reason: The bundled text does not contain any provision exempting an entity from filing all lobbying disclosure reports based on a total-expenditure de minimis amount; the only expenditure limits shown (e.g., §305.0063’s $1,000 modified reporting election) still require filing.

The statute text provided contains an hours-per-quarter de minimis time provision (§305.003(b-3)) but no percentage-of-compensated-time threshold, so the requested percent-based exemption cannot be answered from the bundle.
